adapter_behavior: LocalVisionAdapter loads Alfred's local vision config, discovers Ollama tags, checks known vision model names and /api/show metadata for image capability, prefers the configured model when installed, sends images only to the configured local Ollama endpoint, and returns processed/failed/unavailable status for attachment metadata.
example_image_prompt: Describe this pasted resident conversation image.
fallback_behavior: When no compatible local vision model exists, the image remains in runtime/resident_interactions/attachments, attachment metadata records vision_status=unavailable with provider none, and Alfred truthfully states that local visual inspection is unavailable.
known_limitations: No local Ollama vision-capable model was detected in this container during implementation.
Ollama /api/show metadata probing is best-effort and falls back to model-name hints when metadata is unavailable.
The Estate does not install or start Ollama models automatically.
steward_local_smoke_test: Install or confirm a local Ollama vision model -> restart Operations Center -> paste screenshot into Alfred chat -> ask what Alfred sees -> verify mode remains local and attachment vision_status is processed.
